# SAGEMRO (Jinan Euchio Machinery Co., Ltd.)

SAGEMRO takes over the after-sales delivery that laser and metal-forming equipment builders and their
overseas dealers cannot cover themselves: in-warranty on-site service, export commissioning and customer
training, and exchange-unit flow for returned parts. Engineers and parts are organized by SAGEMRO;
work is billed per project or per visit. We do not sell machines.

Content on this site is service information and planning reference. Final diagnosis, pricing, assignment,
and safety requirements are confirmed by technicians for the individual project; no lead time is promised
in advance.

## Main pages

- https://sagemro.com/ — overview of the three delivery forms
- https://sagemro.com/partners/ — support for overseas dealers and agents

- https://sagemro.com/services/remote-diagnostics/ — laser cutting machine remote diagnostics
- https://sagemro.com/services/preventive-maintenance/ — laser cutting machine and press brake maintenance

- https://sagemro.com/services/spare-parts-consumables/ — spare parts and consumables, including exchange units
- https://sagemro.com/services/oem-service-partner/ — OEM after-sales service partner
- https://sagemro.com/services/after-sales-outsourcing/ — outsourced laser equipment field service
- https://sagemro.com/services/overseas-delivery/ — overseas installation, commissioning, and warranty response
- https://sagemro.com/services/third-party-service/ — third-party and multi-brand equipment service

- https://sagemro.com/insights/ — practical service notes and troubleshooting guides
- https://sagemro.com/about/technical-review/ — technical content review policy

## Scope

- This file describes the international site. The China edition is https://sagemro.cn/
- SAGEMRO is a service contractor, not a machine manufacturer or a machine seller
